controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-falco.alerts-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-11T07:00:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-11T11:00:00.000Z"
        AND host.name == "soc-playground"
        AND (falco.output_fields.proc.name == "nginx" OR falco.output_fields.proc.name == "tini" OR falco.output_fields.proc.name == "sshd")
| STATS events = COUNT(*)
        BY falco.output_fields.container.id, falco.output_fields.proc.name
| SORT events DESC
| LIMIT 20
